meta.estimator: masked ridge LS over symmetric C (ridge 1e-8*tr(G)/dim), active = w > 1.5*wmin; families 'ii+ib', 'ib', 'ii'; 'naive' = H^+ R H^+T with R = theta + w_II (diag filled by row mean)

settings.known: true theta and lam/eta; scored on full Sigma: relF=||C-S||/||S||, bw=BW^2/trS (no scale fit)
settings.scale: same C_hat; bw scale-fitted = 1 - F^2/(trC trS); cos = Frobenius cosine
settings.contrast: theta fitted as free offset; scored on P C P vs P S P, scale fitted

meta.bw_note: C_hat PSD-clipped before BW; 'neg' = fraction of spectral mass removed
meta.baselines: identity, diag(Sigma), rank-k truncation (k=#clusters>=3), untrained net (equilibrium violated), oracle_mask = Sigma restricted to within-part-support pairs
meta.parts: parts-sum readout theta 11^T + sum_k c_k h_k h_k^T/|h_k|^2 with c_k = summed active I-B weight of a member (contrast version drops theta 11^T)
meta.info: rank/n_params of the measurement operator on symmetric matrices (+theta if fitted), cond = ratio of largest to smallest nonzero singular value
meta.training: readout applied along training (equilibrium assumption violated before convergence); seeds 0-2; steps of dt=0.05
meta.masks: labelled comparison: fixed sparse potential-synapse mask p (I-I and I-B) at equilibrium, ii+ib readout
